question_text: Which of the following Venn-diagrams correctly represents the relationship among Females, Doctors, Patients? (a) (b) (c) (d)

In the following figure, triangle represents the engineers ; Circle represents the doctors and rectangle represents the architects. 20 4 2 1 3 15 10 (i) How many female executives are there in the organisation? (a) 5 (b) 10 (c) 15 (d) 11 (ii) How many technical female staff are in the organisation who have done MBA? (a) 2 (b) 3 (c) 4 (d) 6

The triangle represents executives, the circle represents females, the rectangle represents MBAs and the square represents technical staff. The numbers given in the diagram represent the number of persons in that particular category. 2 3 4 6 10 5 11 15 25 (i) How many female executives are there in the organisation? (a) 5 (b) 10 (c) 15 (d) 11 (ii) How many technical female staff are in the organisation who have done MBA? (a) 2 (b) 3 (c) 4 (d) 6

Square represents the doctors, Rectangle represents the females, Circle represents the engineers, Triangle represents the singers. 2 12 7 3 8 10 5 (i) How many female engineers are there who are not doctors? (a) 14 (b) 7 (c) 5 (d) 12 (ii) How many females are there who are singers? (a) 2 (b) 5 (c) 0 (d) 7 (iii) How many singers are there who are engineers and doctors? (a) 3 (b) 8 (c) 11 (d) 7

In the following figure, triangle represents the educated persons; Square represents the boys: rectangle repre- sents the dancers and circle represents the unemployed persons. 3 3 4 1 2 7 6 5 8 (i) How many educated boys are there who are not dancers? (a) 4 (b) 7 (c) 3 (d) 2 (ii) How many dancers are there who are educated? (a) 4 (b) 2 (c) 1 (d) 7 (iii) How many educated unemployed persons are there who are dancers? (a) 0 (b) 1 (c) 2 (d) 3

In an examination, 70% students passed in Hindi and 60% students passed in English while 30% students passed in both Hindi and English. Then answer the following questions: 70% 60% 30% (i) What are the percentage of students who passed only in Hindi? (a) 70% (b) 60% (c) 40% (d) 30% (ii) What are the percentage of students who passed only in English? (a) 70% (b) 40% (c) 60% (d) 30%

There are total 500 students in a class, out of which 300 students speak Hindi and 400 students speak English. Then answer the following questions: (i) How many students are there who speak both Hindi and English? (a) 300 (b) 400 (c) 100 (d) 200 (ii) How many students are there who speak only Hindi? (a) 200 (b) 50 (c) 100 (d) 150 (iii) How many students are there who speak only English? (a) 100 (b) 200 (c) 300 (d) 50

In a class, 30 students passed in Mathe-matics, 50 students passed in English and 80 students passed in Reasoning. 5 students passed in both Mathematics and English. 15 students passed in English and Reaso-ning and 10 students passed in Mathe-matics and Reasoning. 2 students passed in English, Reasoning and Mathematics. (i) How many students have passed only in Mathematics? (a) 17 (b) 15 (c) 18 (d) 20 (ii) How many students have passed only in English? (a) 35 (b) 30 (c) 31 (d) 32 (iii) How many students have passed only in Reasoning? (a) 55 (b) 57 (c) 60 (d) 62 (iv) What is the total number of students? (a) 150 (b) 160 (c) 132 (d) 130

In a class, 300 students passed in Hindi, 200 students passed in English and 250 students passed in Mathematics. 50 students passed in Hindi and English, 25 students passed in English and Mathe-matics and 75 students passed in Mathe-matics and Hindi. 20 students passed in all there subjects Hindi, English and Mathematics. (i) What is the total number of students? (a) 750 (b) 700 (c) 620 (d) 650 (ii) How many students have passed only in Mathematics and English? (a) 25 (b) 30 (c) 5 (d) 20 (iii) How many students have passed only in Hindi and English? (a) 20 (b) 40 (c) 30 (d) 50 (iv) How many students have passed only in Mathematics? (a) 150 (b) 170 (c) 160 (d) 180

There are total 600 students in a class. 300 students passed in Mathematics, 200 students in English and 100 students in Hindi. 50 students passed in Hindi and English, 75 students in English and Mathematics and 30 students passed in Mathematics and Hindi. 20 students passed in all three subjects Hindi, English and Mathematics. (i) How many students failed only in English and Mathematics? (a) 35 (b) 20 (c) 30 (d) 40 (ii) How many students failed only in English and Hindi? (a) 200 (b) 215 (c) 210 (d) 220 (iii) What is the total number of students passed? (a) 465 (b) 450 (c) 400 (d) 480 (iv) How many students failed in all three subjects? (a) 120 (b) 135 (c) 150 (d) 130

There are total 700 students in a class. 200 students passed in Mathematics, 150 students in English and 300 students in Hindi. 50 students passed in Mathematics and English and 20 students passed in Hindi and Mathematics. 30 students passed in English and Hindi only. 10 students passed in all three subjects English, Hindi and Mathematics. (i) What is the number of students who have passed? (a) 600 (b) 550 (c) 150 (d) 400 (ii) What is the number of students who have failed in all three subjects? (a) 600 (b) 550 (c) 150 (d) 400 (iii) What is the number of students who have failed in Hindi only? (a) 40 (b) 60 (c) 10 (d) 80 (iv) What is the number of students who have failed in English only? (a) 10 (b) 20 (c) 30 (d) 40 (v) What is the number of students who have failed in Mathematics and Hindi only? (a) 30 (b) 70 (c) 10 (d) 40

There are total 800 students in a class. 300 students failed in Mathematics, 200 students in English and 200 students in Science. 50 Students failed in Mathematics and English only and 60 students failed in English and Science only. 70 students failed in Science and Mathematics. 5 Students failed in all three subjects Mathematics, Science and Hindi. (i) What is the number of students who passed in Science only? (a) 50 (b) 100 (c) 150 (d) 30 (ii) What is the number of students who passed in Mathematics only? (a) 80 (b) 50 (c) 60 (d) 40 (iii) What is the number of students who passed in Science and Mathematics only? (a) 80 (b) 85 (c) 70 (d) 90 (iv) What is the number of students who passed in all three subjects? (a) 290 (b) 275 (c) 260 (d) 285 (v) How many students have passed in Mathematics and English? (a) 355 (b) 375 (c) 365 (d) 345
